title: oncoba flagelliflora
intro: Oncoba flagelliflora, commonly known as the 'bloodwood' plant, is a medicinal plant species found in tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating fever, and aiding in the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Oncoba flagelliflora include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its ability to inhibit the growth of certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents of Oncoba flagelliflora include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
